verdict.rationale: Mercury states it syncs with QuickBooks, Xero and NetSuite and uses AI-powered automations to speed up closing the books. Supporting evidence includes auto-attaching receipts to card transactions, API endpoints for transaction categories and metadata, and OAuth access aimed at accounting tools. The direct sync claim, however, is a single marketing line. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of sync behavior (frequency, field and category mapping, expense/reimbursement sync scope), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the accounting sync works as claimed.
